title: Rhythm Rodeo: Musical Horse Obstacle Course
description: A horse gallops along a procedurally generated track while BoomBoxes appear as collectible power-ups and obstacles. The player steers the horse left/right, jumps over barriers, and collects BoomBoxes to build a score multiplier. Each collected BoomBox increases the horse's speed and triggers a visual pulse effect.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a 'Rhythm Rodeo' mini-game. Load horse.glb and BoomBox.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: Use a PerspectiveCamera at a third-person chase angle behind the horse, with directional light, ambient light, and a colored fog for depth. Create an infinite-scrolling ground plane with a grid texture or repeating color strips to convey motion. The horse model should be placed center-screen, scaled appropriately, and automatically move forward (translate the world backward). Place BoomBox models (scaled down to ~0.3) randomly in 3 lanes ahead of the horse, some floating as collectibles (spinning, golden emissive glow) and some on the ground as obstacles (red emissive glow, slightly larger). Interactions (7-8 steps with validation): 1) Press A/D or Left/Right arrows to switch the horse between 3 lanes (validate lane bounds -1,0,1). 2) Press Space to jump (validate horse must be grounded before jumping, use a smooth parabolic arc). 3) Colliding with a spinning golden BoomBox increases score by 100×multiplier and increments the multiplier (validate multiplier caps at 5x). 4) Colliding with a red obstacle BoomBox resets multiplier to 1x and flashes the screen red (validate health > 0). 5) Player has 3 health points displayed as UI hearts; hitting 3 obstacles ends the game. 6) A speed parameter increases by 0.5 for every 3 golden BoomBoxes collected (validate max speed cap of 8). 7) Display an HTML overlay HUD showing score, multiplier, speed, and health. 8) On game over, show a restart button that resets all parameters. Use requestAnimationFrame loop, detect collisions via bounding box intersection, and ensure BoomBoxes recycle when behind the camera. Add subtle camera shake on obstacle hit.
